s.n: Talent quest party pies and sauce
s.note: Bite-size gravy beef pies, for the contest the girls didn't win
s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion, stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp tomato sauce and 250ml beef stock and simmer 15 minutes until thick, then cool. Cut 24 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and press into mini muffin tins. Fill, top with rounds cut from 2 sheets puff pastry, pinch the edges and brush with egg. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve hot with tomato sauce.

s.n: Corned beef in parsley white sauce on toast
s.note: Sliced corned beef in parsley white sauce on thick toast, a plain 1960s tea.
s.how: Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g plain flour for 1 minute and whisk in 500ml warm milk until thick, about 8 minutes. Add 3 tbsp chopped parsley, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper. Fold in 400g of thickly sliced cooked corned beef from the deli and warm through for 4 minutes. Serve over 8 slices of thick toasted white bread.

m.note: Topside roast, pumpkin and gravy. Dave swore to guard the girls with his life.
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg topside at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin. Cook 300g peas. Stir 2 tbsp flour into the roasting tin, add 400ml stock and simmer into gravy.

w.note: Butter sponge squares in chocolate and coconut, a taste of Cummeragunja
w.how: Bake a butter sponge from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour and cut into cubes. Dip in icing of 300g icing sugar, 30g cocoa and milk and roll in 200g desiccated coconut. Set on a rack.

d.note: Strong coffee on condensed milk and ice. Dave slept in his car again.
d.how: Brew 500ml very strong coffee from 60g dark ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in each of 4 glasses, pour over the hot coffee and stir. Fill with ice and serve straight away.
